<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (–CH₃) groups in the unknown molecule. The easiest way is to retrieve its ¹H NMR spectrum, identify signals in the typical methyl region (~0.8–1.2 ppm) and count how many distinct methyl resonances are present. This will give the number of methyl groups.</thought>
